lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately seven vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gills, arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern with consistent inter-blob spacing within columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a lattice-like structure where the high-luminance blobs act as anchor nodes on the stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with highlight on the dorsal edge and localized shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of stochastic, smaller high-luminance spots that deviate from the structured grid pattern of the lateral flank.
